notes.title: Game Release!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! This is our very first game release. A small and interesting horror experience we have passionately worked on for a couple of years. Take on the role of the unsuspecting Dr. Reed returning to her job at a hospital, but tasked with an overnight shift trying to uncover which of the 10 quarantined patients was dosed with a mutative drug. Keep an eye on your patients, utilize your office computer, and watch your time! Not monitoring your patients and working too slowly will seal your fate.

We plan on maintaining and keeping the game updated with bug fixes and any other necessary changes. Please post any issues in the community tab, and we will try to sort game problems out with small updates. The current release build of the game is 1.0.0, so in the near future we do plan to push it up to 1.1 to include quality-of-life fixing and a few new planned features! We also have it planned up to version 1.2, which will eventually be the update to showcase a new ending...
